name: Activities Layer
description:
Groups windows and workspaces into Activities (e.g. "Work", "Study"). Only the active Activity's windows and workspaces are shown; the others are hidden from the desktop, Overview, Alt+Tab and the dash. Switch with shortcuts, the panel menu or D-Bus.

The extension also runs on the lock screen (unlock-dialog session mode) only so that locking does not disable it and briefly reveal and re-hide every window of every Activity. While locked it removes its panel indicator; its shortcuts are inactive.
